independent_values.source: review/three_kink_C8.py (phase-1 reviewer three-kink code, ddd added; dps 30)

exact_two_kink_atoms.remark: Z2_*, Q2_* complete rationals; EZ2_*, EQ2_* exact (MZV constant at eps^0 l^0); may be used directly as raw inputs and are targets for any engine value of them

structural_zeros.top_log: for a jet d_v^i d_delta^j of a normalized response of order n (C_n, K_n), [eps^0 l^k] = 0 for k > n - 1 + i + 2j; checked by the RG formulas (the predicted [l^(top+1)] vanishes identically) and on the phase-2 data

pole_cancellation.statement: every [eps^p l^k], p < 0, of every normalized jet vanishes; the raw windows needed for the new jets are poles_C8.json -> raw_needed_for_new_jets (all log powers)

structural_zeros.below_tight_bound: the 12 safe-minus-tight scalars below the tight bound (raw_requirements_C8.json -> safe_minus_tight) vanish

data_dependent_RG.statement: for every C/K jet of order n >= 5 used by the C8 inputs (incl. C9, d_delta C7, d_v K8, d_v^2 K6, d_v d_delta K6, d_delta^2 C5) the coefficients [eps^0 l^k], k = 2 .. top+1, are predicted from lower-order data (normalized C, K and E jets at log powers < k) and the beta inputs
data_dependent_RG.l0_identity: the [l^0] part of the same identity reproduces the recurrence for all 35 inputs (rg_logs_C8.json -> l0_identity_equals_recurrence), including lambda6, j7 and b9

Kv: coefficient of EQ6_v[eps^0 l^0].note: same, X_E = [eps^0 l^0] d_v (EE Q6) (via lambda6_v)

finite_cutoff_cross_check_quantities.definition: full ordered integral over Omega_n(eps) of the differentiated kernel at (v,delta) = (1,0), before any eps expansion; E moments with the reflected first source derivative
finite_cutoff_cross_check_quantities.how_to_use: two independent project routes (engine series at that eps vs direct cubature); archived values of some of them (e.g. Q6_vv(1/10)) are sealed in comparison_C8/ for the final comparison only. Finite-cutoff cubature checks conventions; it cannot isolate the single logs of the 6-9 kink atoms.

archive_derived_targets_sealed: rational projections pi_0 of the ten inputs, R6, R8, R_tail, R9, C8^(0) = 88 and the raw rational scalars (note l.1176-1227)
singular rational predictions of Q6_vd and Q8_v (note l.1236-1246)
